dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Thickwood Hills Area (NTS 84A/NE) (GIS data, point features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the point features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 555, Surficial Geology of the Thickwood Hills Area (NTS 84A/NE).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Thickwood Hills Area (NTS 84A/NE) (GIS data, point features)
